adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained offset beginning ~567 (sharp rise in E/U, gradual N increase) and returning ~573 (sharp drop in E/U, N recovers). P1 (560–573) starts too early—N shows no step at 560, only gradual rise; P2 (563–573) still includes pre-offset noise (E/U flat until ~567); P3 (567–567) is a single-point spike, not a platform. Interior observations (568–572) are persistently offset in E/U (~+20 MAD, ~+10 MAD) with smooth motion, confirming a genuine temporary platform. Return at 573 is clear in all components. Thus only a single platform from 567 to 573 is supported by observations.
